fragments.text: I meditate on righteousness to ascribe righteousness to my Creator; I ask for judgments of righteousness and raise my voice like a Shofar.
When none proclaims in righteousness and none pursues righteousness, I call out for a hearing in righteousness in a voice mingled with the Shofar.
I understood through my knowledge when I raised my mind far distant and know that the utterance of Teruah sounded at the Revelation through the Shofar.
By blowing Teruah I appease my shepherd, who strengthens my arm through the powerful sound of the Shofar.
I approached on the day of justice to plead for myself with justice; He reveals the depths of justice through the curdling sound of the Shofar.
If I am guilty in justice according to the decree of law and justice, may my throat restrain the severity of justice through my voice together with the Shofar.
Seek out and bring healing for the wound, let the mind of the wounded people be soothed by the sound of the Shofar.
Let freedom for the banished, who are sold to a strange people, and for every human
creature be granted through the sound of the Shofar.
He who has sinned in adultery, through the embrace of the strange woman, and is led, penned up in judgment, dreads the sound of the Shofar.
He who was punished in anger and repents to be purified, his bent heart avails him at the sound of the bent Shofar.
If the evil impulse had tempted him and he is accused in justice, clemency hastens to hold him up at the tremulous sound of the Shofar.
Just as the sound passed through the Shofar, so does the Lord cut short the speech of the accuser at the breath of the sound of the Shofar.
Of all the sounds that are heard in assemblies, He has made incumbent on communities the sound of the blast of the Shofar.
They who planned crooked deeds, deserving of death by stoning, trembled when the cedars broke at the report of the sound of the Shofar (on the day of the Revelation).
The Eternal of every year has set apart this day from the whole year and appointed it for the Rose (Israel) for a proclamation of freedom through the sound of the Shofar.
There will be extraordinary love greater than the previous love; the sin of
the whole year is banished by the sound of the Shofar.
The form of the nine benedictions corresponds to the nine Shofar blasts; in His purity He allows them to entreat through the prescribed sound of the Shofar.
Even those stained with evil, when they repent of transgression, Thou dost soothe their wound at the sound of the cry of the Shofar.
Better than the sacrificial bullock and the splendid ram is the day appointed for the sound of renewal of the Shofar.
The evil impulse is broken and the accuser disgraced and the upright heart refreshed at the sound of beauty of the Shofar.
When once they blew the Shofar (before Jericho), they cleaved asunder the valley; they caused cities to sink through the tumult of the sound of the Shofar.
All the multitude of the wicked will shake with trembling when they cry out aloud with a sound as piercing as the Shofar.
When His voice is heard, every settlement is terrified, He blows away peoples in a hurricane
through the stormy sound of the Shofar.
For those who know Him, there is comfort, it is reckoned a good sign for the establishment of peace through the pleasant sound of the Shofar.
They who reject Him will be cut down, the faithless will be uprooted, rebels will sink down through the powerful sound of the Shofar.
It sounds long drawn-out blasts and then short sharp notes, Teruah and Tekiah are included in the threefold sound of the Shofar.
It spreads fear, shakes nations so that they speak of flight from the menacing sound of the Shofar.
It tears down walls and makes an end of wars, like the roaring of the waves is the roaring sound of the Shofar.
When the Lord revealed His will to His own people on Mount Sinai, the Revelation concluded with the long drawn out sound of the Shofar.
When once the secret of redemption will be revealed to those exalted, jubilation and rejoicing He will proclaim through the sound of the Shofar.
On the tenth of Tishri was it sounded, even on the day of the Sabbath rest, sins were obliterated through the ringing sound of the
Shofar.
Sins are annulled and slavery is lifted and works are restored through the embracing sound of the Shofar.
Destroy and cast away the realm of Seir, remember its transgression at the reverberating sound of the Shofar.
Let the gates of the city sink and disappear, let fright overcome great and small at the roaring sound of the Shofar.
Threefold miraculous signs, three hundred horns set up a loud lament in Midian at the accompanying sound of the Shofar.
Israel’s hosts rejoiced at witnessing the miracles when the Creator showed His might through the sweet sound of the Shofar.
A slender voice descended upon earth, there were threefold sounds of thunder at the Revelation when sounds were given on the Shofar.
A threefold sound of the horn will I blow this day as a symbol of the threefold call of the Shofar (at the redemption) that will one day resound from the future Shofar.
I pray to heaven and my eyes are lifted up that I may be allowed to see the gathering of the exiles at the loud sound of the Shofar.
The fourth of the wild beasts (that Daniel saw) will fall into the fire, among the sparking flames at the fiery sound of the Shofar.
Thou wilt stir up sleep to pay retribution to the oppressor, and shatter his multitudes with the mighty sound of the Shofar.
Thou wilt free the Rose (Israel) and let redemption dawn, revive those who slumber with the rousing sound of the Shofar.
Thou wilt march from Hermon to destroy Admon, bring cooling to Tsalmon with the massive sound of the Shofar.
Thou wilt step in our midst as once in the wilderness when Thou didst give us the Torah and once again wilt Thou allow to be heard in the Sanctuary a voice that sounds like that of the Shofar.
